properties.notes: Use of the building as seven (7) residential flats, insertion of roof lights and courtyards to lower ground floor level, secondary glazing to the front elevation at lower ground, ground and first floors, and replacement windows to the rear elevation at ground, first and mezzanine levels, together with associated internal alterations, plant, waste and cycle storage, and hard landscaping to the rear. Linked to land use swap with Macintosh House, Beaumont Street (RN16/09208/FULL).
